metadata.article_title: Time for performance of promise, when no application is to be made and no time is specified.

article.title: Time for performance of promise, when no application is to be made and no time is specified.
article.content:
46Time for performance of promise, when no application is to be made and no time is specified.

Section 46  ·  Chapter IV  ·  Time and place for performance  ·  page 23 of the Act
Where, by the contract, a promisor is to perform his promise without application by the promisee, and no time for performance is specified, the engagement must be performed within a reasonable time.
Explanation.—The question “what is a reasonable time” is, in each particular case, a question of fact.
